title: United Nations General Assembly voting data: each member's recorded vote on each resolution adopted by a recorded vote, 1946 onwards
provider: The Dag Hammarskjöld Library, United Nations: UN Digital Library, record 4060887, https://digitallibrary.un.org/record/4060887
credit: © United Nations. Dag Hammarskjöld Library, UN Digital Library
format: One CSV, a row a member's vote: undl_id, ms_code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3), ms_name, ms_vote (Y, N, A, X), date, session, resolution, draft, committee_report, meeting, title, agenda_title, subjects, vote_note and the totals. About 370 MB (the file of 15 October 2026). Read a session at a time by data/formats/unvotes.py; written as a record of votes by data/products/multilateral_cases.py general-assembly.
coverage: Resolutions of the General Assembly adopted by a recorded vote, from 1946; drafts that failed are not included (the Library's own note).
licence: The Library's terms: its content, data and metadata may be used free of charge for non-commercial purposes, with the acknowledgment "© United Nations" and the site's address; web scraping and automated downloads are not permitted without the Library's approval. The data library therefore never fetches the file: a person downloads it and names it. Products made from it are kept in the cache only, and never committed or redistributed.
citation: United Nations Dag Hammarskjöld Library, "United Nations General Assembly voting data", UN Digital Library, record 4060887.
